features.title: Create/update a dress: code, photos, rental price, standard deposit, status (available / renting / cleaning / retired)
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: create shipped with bootstrap; this entry adds update + retire + photos. BE: migration 0003 photo_urls text[] (photos = staff-pasted LINKS; binary upload is a deliberate MVP non-goal), SqlRepositoryBase.serialize maps JS arrays -> sql.array(text[]); PATCH /dresses/:id update-dress (partial merge: undefined keeps, explicit null clears sizeLabel/notes; code change re-checks uniqueness -> 409; dress:update policy) + POST /dresses/:id/retire (owner-only dress:retire policy from bootstrap, ONE-WAY — reactivate has no registered policy, fail-closed; already-retired -> 409); DressEntity.changeCode added; status model stays active/retired (renting/cleaning derived from rentals — documented bootstrap deviation vs the title wording). BE gates: build/lint/arch(137 modules, 0 violations)/test(32, +8: update merge/null-clear/dup-code/same-code-skips-check, retire happy/404/409). Contract regenerated (useUpdateDressHttpControllerUpdate, useRetireDressHttpControllerRetire, photoUrls on DressResponseDto). FE: DressFormDialog dual-mode (edit prefill from dress prop, re-primed per open; edit sends the FULL form — blank nullables as explicit nulls), photos textarea (one link/line, max 10, http(s)-validated), detail actions Sửa + Ngừng khai thác (window.confirm, invalidate list+get, 409 -> already-retired toast), photo thumbnail strip; ui/textarea added. FE gates: check/lint/test(31, +4)/build; arch 11/11 after this commit. Runtime vs fresh compose DB: smoke.sh now 26 checks — PATCH 200 then GET proves merge ('Váy cưới ren trắng (sửa):2:1800000': name+price+2 photos changed, code/deposit kept), PATCH taken code 409, PATCH unknown 404, retire 200, retire again 409, availability of the retired dress = false (cross-feature). Proxy proof :5173->:3000: PATCH 200, retire 200. Deferred: photo binary upload; reactivate endpoint; a 403 retire proof needs a non-owner user (PoliciesGuard fail-closed proven at bootstrap).

features.title: Create rental: customer + per-dress date range + cleaning buffer after return; overlapping bookings rejected at the DB level (Postgres daterange exclusion constraint), not only in application code
features.evidence: 2026-07-30: BE slice modules/rentals — create-rental command over the rentals+rental_items aggregate (RentalPeriod VO, item price defaults to the dress standard price), DressLookupAdapter reads the dresses TABLE (no catalog imports); gates green: build/lint/arch(116 modules, 0 violations)/test(22, incl. buffer + daterange specs). Proxy proof :5173->:3000: SPA 200, login 200, rental 201, buffer-overlap 409. Deferred: per-item price override UI (API already accepts price), rentals list/detail read slices.
